title: Why does SSA need phi nodes?

cast.name: Kai
cast.role: Junior compiler dev whose optimizer folds constants

glossary.note: Every variable is assigned exactly once.

glossary.full: A merge that picks a value by the incoming edge
glossary.note: Sits at the start of a join block.

glossary.full: Blocks reached from a block that it doesn't strictly dominate

glossary.note: The compiler infrastructure whose IR uses SSA.

key_points: At a join, renaming alone cannot choose between x1 and x2; a phi node does.
Cytron places phis at the iterated dominance frontier of each variable's definitions.
LLVM mem2reg promotes stack slots to SSA the same way.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Kai's optimizer folds constants. Today it folds one too many.

beats.speaker: kai
beats.text: I renamed each assignment so every variable is set exactly once. Single assignment. Clean.

beats.speaker: kai
beats.text: So which one does the use read: x1 or x2?
beats.say: So which one does the use read: x one or x two?

beats.speaker: noor
beats.text: That depends on which way the branch went. Renaming can't decide that at compile time.

beats.speaker: kai
beats.text: My optimizer picks x2, the last one it saw.
beats.say: My optimizer picks x two, the last one it saw.

beats.speaker: noor
beats.text: And whenever c is true, you've shipped a bug.

beats.speaker: noor
beats.text: The fix is a phi node at the top of the join block. It picks x1 if control came from then, and x2 if from else.
beats.say: The fix is a phi node at the top of the join block. It picks x one if control came from then, and x two if from else.

beats.speaker: kai
beats.text: Great. But where do they go? Everywhere?

beats.speaker: noor
beats.text: Everywhere is slow. Cytron's algorithm places the fewest. For each variable, start with the blocks that define it.

beats.speaker: noor
beats.text: Take their iterated dominance frontier: blocks they reach but don't strictly dominate. Put a phi at each.

beats.speaker: noor
beats.text: One walk down the dominator tree. Each use takes the newest name above it.

beats.speaker: kai
beats.text: So the pass reads x3, and folds nothing wrong.
beats.say: So the pass reads x three, and folds nothing wrong.

beats.speaker: noor
beats.text: LLVM's mem2reg uses the same idea to turn stack slots into SSA values.
beats.say: L L V M's mem two reg uses the same idea to turn stack slots into S S A values.
